note: What a server sends to change the state of an inhibitor, and say how long the new state lasts. The header names the unit this is about.

bits.name: duration
bits.note: How long the state lasts, in seconds. 240 and 300 are observed, both with the bit above clear, and 0 with it set.

bits.name: alive
bits.note: Set in those observed with no duration.

fields.name: state
fields.note: Which state. Observed 0, sent as the inhibitor falls.

fields.name: duration
fields.note: How long the state lasts. Observed 300; what the figure counts is not recorded here.
